boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain New York Institute of Technology
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations near NYIT's Old Westbury campus with officially posted evening hours.

cards.title: Old Westbury Diner
cards.subtitle: 4 Glen Cove Road, Old Westbury
cards.notes: Use the diner’s posted 10 p.m. closing time as a conservative evening option; confirm service availability before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: An Old Westbury dining room with official hours through 10 p.m. every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Westbury Diner lists hours until 10 p.m. Monday through Friday and 10 p.m. on weekends.
cards.source_title: Old Westbury Diner — Contact & Info
cards.access_notes: Official site lists closing at 10 p.m. daily; verify before travel because hours can change.

cards.title: Chick and Tender Westbury
cards.subtitle: 1236 Old Country Road, Westbury
cards.notes: Plan around the officially listed midnight close Sunday–Thursday or 1 a.m. close Friday–Saturday, and check ordering status first.
cards.short_summary: A Westbury food stop with the latest officially posted hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick and Tender’s Westbury page lists hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Chick and Tender Westbury — Hours & Location
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 12 a.m. closes Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: La Chalateca Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 219 Nassau Street, Westbury
cards.notes: For a later weekend food run, use the restaurant’s posted 4 a.m. Friday, Saturday, and Sunday closing times; verify before going.
cards.short_summary: A Westbury restaurant whose official site lists late weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: La Chalateca lists 4 a.m. closing times on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, and 11 p.m. on Monday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: La Chalateca Restaurant
cards.access_notes: Official site lists weekend hours through 4 a.m.; check current operations before departure.

cards.title: Golden Wok Express
cards.subtitle: 1610 Old Country Road, Westbury
cards.notes: Use the posted 10 p.m. weekday or 10:30 p.m. Friday–Saturday closing time when planning an evening takeout stop.
cards.short_summary: A Westbury restaurant with official hours extending to 10:30 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Golden Wok Express lists hours until 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Golden Wok Express — Official Site
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday service until 10:30 p.m.; confirm before travel.

cards.title: Cafe Baci
cards.subtitle: 1636 Old Country Road, Westbury
cards.notes: Choose a Friday or Saturday evening if you need the restaurant’s latest posted 11 p.m. dine-in and pickup window.
cards.short_summary: An Italian restaurant with official Friday and Saturday hours through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Cafe Baci lists dine-in and pickup hours until 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Cafe Baci — Westbury NY
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday hours until 11 p.m.; verify service before leaving.

cards.title: Steve's Piccola Bussola
cards.subtitle: 649 Old Country Road, Westbury
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s posted 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday kitchen close for a late dinner plan; curbside pickup is listed.
cards.short_summary: A Westbury restaurant with official kitchen hours through 10 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Steve’s Piccola Bussola lists kitchen hours until 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday and states curbside pickup is available.
cards.source_title: Steve's Piccola Bussola
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday kitchen service until 10 p.m.; confirm before traveling.

cards.title: Tesoro's
cards.subtitle: 967 Old Country Road, Westbury
cards.notes: Schedule around the posted 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday close, and contact the restaurant directly for any same-day change.
cards.short_summary: A Westbury restaurant with official Friday and Saturday hours until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Tesoro’s lists Friday hours from noon to 10 p.m. and Saturday hours from 2:30 p.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Tesoro's — Home
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 10 p.m. closing on Friday and Saturday; verify before departure.

cards.entity_name: Nan Xiang Xiao Long Bao — Country Road at Westbury
cards.title: Nan Xiang Xiao Long Bao
cards.subtitle: 1500 Old Country Road, Westbury
cards.notes: The official locations page lists this Westbury stop until 10 p.m. daily; treat it as an evening option, not a late-after-midnight run.
cards.short_summary: A Westbury location with an official daily closing time of 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Nan Xiang Xiao Long Bao lists its Country Road at Westbury location at 1500 Old Country Road with hours of 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Nan Xiang Xiao Long Bao — Locations
cards.access_notes: Official locations page lists daily hours until 10 p.m.; verify before travel.

cards.title: Giulio Cesare Ristorante
cards.subtitle: 18 Ellison Avenue, Westbury
cards.notes: Reserve this for a Friday or Saturday evening: the official site lists a 10 p.m. Saturday kitchen close and takeout availability.
cards.short_summary: A Westbury restaurant with official Saturday hours through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Giulio Cesare Ristorante lists Saturday hours of 5 to 10 p.m. and says it is open for indoor dining and takeout.
cards.source_title: Giulio Cesare Ristorante
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Saturday service until 10 p.m.; confirm availability before departure.

cards.title: Salisbury Tavern Kitchen
cards.subtitle: 850 Carman Avenue, Westbury
cards.notes: Use only the restaurant kitchen’s posted hours: it serves food until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday; the venue also has a bar.
cards.short_summary: A Westbury kitchen with official Friday and Saturday hours through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Salisbury Tavern lists kitchen hours until 11 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Salisbury Tavern Sports Bar & Grill
cards.access_notes: Use the officially listed kitchen hours only: Friday and Saturday until 11 p.m.; under-21 visitors should focus on food service.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase campus and student-access activities verified through New York Tech sources.

cards.entity_name: Hicksville LIRR – Long Island Campus Shuttle
cards.title: Ride the Hicksville Shuttle
cards.subtitle: Hicksville LIRR station ↔ Long Island campus
cards.notes: Meet a classmate at Hicksville and ride together to campus. Bring a current New York Tech ID; service runs on class days in fall and spring.
cards.short_summary: A free weekday link between Hicksville station and the Old Westbury campus.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech states that this weekday shuttle is free and requires a current, valid New York Tech ID to board.
cards.source_title: Hicksville LIRR – Long Island Campus Shuttle | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: For New York Tech ID holders; Monday–Friday when fall and spring classes are in session. Check the posted schedule before leaving.

cards.title: Visit the Grizzly Cupboard
cards.subtitle: Student Activity Center, second floor
cards.notes: Place an order through PantrySoft, then pick it up with a friend. Inventory changes, so select a day and time that works for you.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus pantry for eligible Long Island students.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech describes the Grizzly Cupboard as an on-campus pantry offering free nonperishable food items and lists its Long Island location in SAC.
cards.source_title: Bear Bytes: Healthy Eating and Student Support Program | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Long Island students use New York Tech credentials to order via PantrySoft; the page notes the pantry is closed during summer.

cards.title: Browse Tech Threads
cards.subtitle: Student Activity Center, Room 132
cards.notes: Make an appointment with a friend before an interview or career fair. Choose from available donated professional clothes and accessories to keep.
cards.short_summary: A Long Island professional-clothing resource for New York Tech students.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech says Tech Threads gives students free access to professional clothing and accessories, and identifies SAC Room 132 as its Long Island location.
cards.source_title: Tech Threads | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: For New York Tech students; make an appointment. Available items and sizes vary with donations.

cards.title: Start a LinkedIn Learning Course
cards.subtitle: Online with New York Tech single sign-on
cards.notes: Pick a short course and work through the first lesson together between classes. Use your New York Tech single sign-on to begin.
cards.short_summary: On-demand professional and personal-development courses for the university community.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech states that LinkedIn Learning is available at no cost to all its students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: LinkedIn Learning | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Available to New York Tech students, faculty, and staff through SSO; courses are online and on demand.

cards.entity_name: Our Money Matters Financial Wellness Tool
cards.title: Try the Financial Wellness Tool
cards.subtitle: Online with New York Tech credentials
cards.notes: Open the budgeting tools or a short video with a roommate, then compare one practical takeaway for the week without sharing private financial details.
cards.short_summary: A personalized financial-wellness platform with articles, videos, and calculators.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech says its Our Money Matters financial wellness tool is free and accessible with New York Tech credentials.
cards.source_title: Financial Success and Wellness | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Use New York Tech credentials. The platform includes budgeting resources, articles, calculators, and videos.

cards.entity_name: New York Tech Libraries Interlibrary Loan
cards.title: Request an Interlibrary Loan
cards.subtitle: Online through New York Tech Libraries
cards.notes: Find a book or article the campus library does not own, then submit the request form. Compare sources with a study partner when it arrives.
cards.short_summary: A way for New York Tech students to borrow materials from other libraries.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech Libraries says interlibrary loan lets faculty and students borrow materials not owned by NYIT and is available free of charge, subject to stated limits.
cards.source_title: NYIT Library Policies | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: For New York Tech faculty and students. The policy sets a limit of 30 articles per fall and spring semester; exceptional copyright or lender costs may be offered for approval.

cards.entity_name: The Chronicle of Higher Education Premium Access
cards.title: Read The Chronicle on Campus
cards.subtitle: New York Tech Libraries online resources
cards.notes: Pull up a higher-education story while on campus and discuss it over a study break. Follow the library’s instructions if you need off-campus access.
cards.short_summary: Premium access to higher-education reporting from the New York Tech library page.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech Libraries states that on-campus premium access to The Chronicle of Higher Education is free.
cards.source_title: Find and Request | New York Tech Libraries
cards.access_notes: Free premium access is specified for on-campus use; the library provides separate instructions for off-campus access.

cards.title: Read Connections Are Everything
cards.subtitle: Project MUSE download via New York Tech resource guide
cards.notes: Download the student-focused book and choose one prompt to discuss with a classmate. Keep the conversation concrete: people, questions, and next steps.
cards.short_summary: A student-oriented book about building meaningful college connections.
cards.evidence_claim: A New York Tech strategic-planning glossary identifies Connections Are Everything as a student companion book and says its full Project MUSE download is available at no cost.
cards.source_title: Know Your Students & Strategic Planning Glossary | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: The cited New York Tech guide directs readers to a no-cost full download at Project MUSE.

cards.title: Take Bloomberg Market Concepts
cards.subtitle: Online Bloomberg e-learning library
cards.notes: Work through an introductory financial-markets module with a friend, pausing to compare unfamiliar terms. Use the university-provided student access rather than buying a course.
cards.short_summary: An introductory Bloomberg e-learning course on financial markets.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech reports that Bloomberg Market Concepts training is available at no cost to New York Tech students.
cards.source_title: NYIT Magazine, Spring 2023 | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: The university publication identifies the training as available at no cost to New York Tech students.

cards.title: Explore Bloomberg ESG Training
cards.subtitle: Online Bloomberg e-learning course
cards.notes: Choose an ESG lesson and compare how it frames environmental, social, and governance reporting. Treat it as a conversation starter, not investment advice.
cards.short_summary: A Bloomberg e-learning course introducing ESG strategies and reporting.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech reports that Bloomberg ESG training is available at no cost to New York Tech students.
cards.source_title: NYIT Magazine, Spring 2023 | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: The university publication identifies the training as available at no cost to New York Tech students.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Documented study, library, lounge, and outdoor work environments on New York Tech's Long Island campus in Old Westbury.

cards.title: Salten Hall Library
cards.subtitle: Salten Hall, Long Island campus
cards.notes: Bring your NYIT ID and start with the library desks for research-heavy work; ask staff about services or current room availability.
cards.short_summary: The campus library in Salten Hall supports research and individual academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech lists Salten Hall Library at its Old Westbury campus, in Salten Hall rooms 300 and LL01.
cards.source_title: Campus Libraries | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Campus buildings are listed as open Monday–Saturday, 8 a.m.–11:15 p.m.; verify library-specific access before visiting.

cards.title: Salten Hall Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Salten Hall
cards.notes: Use the lower-level reading room for a focused session, and check the campus calendar in case the room is reserved for an event.
cards.short_summary: A student-designed-and-furnished reading room in Salten Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech describes the Salten Hall Reading Room as a study space specifically designed and furnished for students.
cards.source_title: Reading Room Grand Opening Ceremony | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Located in Salten Hall’s lower level; availability can change when the room hosts scheduled events.

cards.title: Salten Commons
cards.subtitle: Salten Hall, Long Island campus
cards.notes: Choose an individual pod for solo work or group seating for a shared review session, keeping pathways and adjacent tables clear.
cards.short_summary: Open study and social space with pods, group seating, couches, and campus-facing windows.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech says Salten Commons has individual study pods, group seating, couches, and large windows as part of Salten Hall’s repurposed study space.
cards.source_title: Completed Projects | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Use during authorized building access; shared seating may be occupied or used for campus programming.

cards.entity_name: Anna Rubin Hall Reservable Study Rooms
cards.title: Anna Rubin Hall Reservable Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Anna Rubin Hall, Long Island campus
cards.notes: Check the room-reservation process before arriving, then use the enclosed setting for a small project meeting or concentrated work block.
cards.short_summary: Renovated reservable study rooms within Anna Rubin Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech reports that renovations to Anna Rubin Hall included reservable study rooms, along with classrooms and lounges.
cards.source_title: Completed Projects | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Reservation requirements and room availability should be confirmed with the applicable campus office.

cards.title: Orso Lounge
cards.subtitle: Student Activities Center, Long Island campus
cards.notes: Set up at a lounge table for a lighter reading or laptop task, and move to a quieter location if activity levels rise.
cards.short_summary: A furnished student lounge beside the Orso Café in the Student Activities Center.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech identifies Orso as a lounge adjacent to the Orso Café in the Student Activities Center, with comfortable furniture and soft lighting.
cards.source_title: Completed Projects | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: This is a shared student-activity space; access and noise levels vary with campus programming.

cards.title: Midge Karr Parklet
cards.subtitle: Outdoor study area near Midge Karr Art and Design Center
cards.notes: Use the wireless-equipped outdoor seating for reading or laptop work in suitable weather, and bring headphones for open-air distractions.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus parklet with wireless access near Midge Karr.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech lists a campus parklet with robust wireless access at Midge Karr.
cards.source_title: Completed Projects | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Outdoor use depends on weather and campus conditions; use only publicly accessible seating areas.

cards.title: Riland Pond Parklet
cards.subtitle: Outdoor study area by Riland Pond
cards.notes: Pick a seat with reliable daylight for a brief outdoor work session, and secure papers and devices against wind or changing weather.
cards.short_summary: A wireless-equipped outdoor parklet by Riland Pond.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech lists a campus parklet with robust wireless access at Riland Pond.
cards.source_title: Completed Projects | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Outdoor use depends on weather and campus conditions; use only publicly accessible seating areas.

cards.title: Academic Quad
cards.subtitle: Outdoor seating area, Long Island campus
cards.notes: Use the wireless-equipped gathering area between academic buildings for a short reading session, while keeping walkways open for campus traffic.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor Academic Quad seating area with wireless access.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech identifies comfortable gathering and seating areas with wireless access at the Academic Quad.
cards.source_title: Completed Projects | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Outdoor seating is weather-dependent and shared with the campus community.

cards.title: Medical School Quad
cards.subtitle: Outdoor seating area, Long Island campus
cards.notes: Use a wireless-equipped seating area for independent reading between appointments or classes, and respect nearby academic and clinical activity.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor Medical School Quad seating area with wireless access.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech identifies comfortable gathering and seating areas with wireless access at the Medical School Quad.
cards.source_title: Completed Projects | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Outdoor seating is weather-dependent; access to adjacent medical-school facilities may be restricted.

cards.entity_name: NYIT de Seversky Mansion Annex Study Spaces
cards.title: NYIT de Seversky Mansion Annex Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: NYIT de Seversky Mansion Annex, Long Island campus
cards.notes: NYITCOM students can confirm access with their program before using the Annex study spaces; plan around wellness-gym and academic-support operations.
cards.short_summary: Program-associated study spaces in the annex of the historic de Seversky Mansion.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2026–2027 NYITCOM catalog states that the NYIT de Seversky Mansion Annex contains academic enrichment offices and study spaces.
cards.source_title: Facilities | College of Osteopathic Medicine | New York Tech Catalog 2026–2027
cards.access_notes: These spaces are associated with NYITCOM facilities; confirm eligibility and current access with the program.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on nearby road corridors, each with a documented visitor activity or feature.

cards.title: Old Westbury Gardens
cards.subtitle: Old Westbury Road corridor
cards.notes: Plan a self-guided walk through the gardens and Westbury House; reserve admission in advance and enter at the posted Old Westbury Road gate.
cards.short_summary: Historic gardens and a house museum at the former Phipps estate.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Westbury Gardens tickets include admission to its gardens and Westbury House at 71 Old Westbury Road.
cards.source_title: Old Westbury Gardens: Plan Your Visit
cards.access_notes: Tickets are required for most visitors; current hours, entry rules, and reservations are published by the Gardens.

cards.entity_name: Planting Fields Arboretum State Historic Park
cards.title: Planting Fields Arboretum State Historic Park
cards.subtitle: Planting Fields Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the official trail map to choose a garden or woodland route, then check park conditions and parking guidance before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A state historic park with gardens, trails, and a historic estate setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Planting Fields Arboretum State Historic Park provides a trail map showing gardens, paths, and plant collections.
cards.source_title: New York State Parks: Planting Fields Arboretum State Historic Park
cards.access_notes: The National Park Service visitor guide lists an $8 parking fee and notes that access details can change.

cards.title: Nassau County Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Northern Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Pair the galleries with the outdoor sculpture garden, and check the museum’s visitor page for the current exhibition and grounds schedule.
cards.short_summary: An art museum with a sculpture garden and marked walking trails.
cards.evidence_claim: Nassau County Museum of Art includes a sculpture park, formal gardens, ponds, woodlands, and marked walking trails.
cards.source_title: Nassau County: Nassau County Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Confirm current museum and outdoor-access arrangements through the museum before visiting.

cards.title: Garvies Point Museum and Preserve
cards.subtitle: Barry Drive corridor
cards.notes: Follow the marked nature trails from the museum area toward the shoreline, and allow time for the geology and archaeology exhibits.
cards.short_summary: A county museum and 62-acre shoreline-and-woods preserve in Glen Cove.
cards.evidence_claim: Garvies Point Museum and Preserve has permanent geology and Native-American archaeology exhibits and about five miles of marked trails.
cards.source_title: Nassau County: Garvies Point Museum and Preserve
cards.access_notes: The county lists museum hours Tuesday through Saturday and separate museum admission charges.

cards.title: Roslyn Grist Mill
cards.subtitle: Old Northern Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: View the preserved watermill from the historic district and use the Landmark Society profile to understand its restoration and industrial history.
cards.short_summary: A preserved Dutch-framed colonial watermill in Roslyn.
cards.evidence_claim: The Roslyn Grist Mill is a Dutch-framed colonial watermill at 1347 Old Northern Boulevard, built in 1715.
cards.source_title: Roslyn Landmark Society: Roslyn Grist Mill
cards.access_notes: Treat this as an exterior historic-site stop unless the preservation organization announces public interior access.

cards.title: Sagamore Hill National Historic Site
cards.subtitle: Cove Neck Road corridor
cards.notes: Walk the grounds or nature trail to the salt marsh and beach; book separately only if you want the guided Roosevelt home tour.
cards.short_summary: Theodore Roosevelt’s historic home, grounds, and waterfront nature trail.
cards.evidence_claim: Sagamore Hill offers free grounds access, a nature trail, beach, pathways, and an Old Orchard Museum; house tours require tickets.
cards.source_title: National Park Service: Sagamore Hill Virtual Visitor Center
cards.access_notes: Grounds are open daily from sunrise to sunset; guided home-tour tickets must be purchased online in advance.

cards.entity_name: Theodore Roosevelt Sanctuary and Audubon Center
cards.title: Theodore Roosevelt Sanctuary and Audubon Center
cards.subtitle: Cove Road corridor
cards.notes: Take the one-mile birding loop through the native-plant garden, staying on marked paths and following the sanctuary’s wildlife-protection rules.
cards.short_summary: An Audubon sanctuary with gardens, ponds, and a one-mile trail network.
cards.evidence_claim: The Theodore Roosevelt Sanctuary and Audubon Center has native-plant gardens, small ponds, and approximately one mile of hiking trails.
cards.source_title: Audubon: Visit Theodore Roosevelt Sanctuary and Audubon Center
cards.access_notes: Trails and gardens are open sunrise to sunset; the site requests a suggested trail-use donation.

cards.title: Muttontown Preserve
cards.subtitle: Muttontown Lane corridor
cards.notes: Pick up a self-guided map and stay on marked trails through the fields, woods, ponds, and documented estate remnants.
cards.short_summary: Nassau County’s largest nature preserve, with marked trails and estate history.
cards.evidence_claim: Muttontown Preserve comprises 550 acres and includes miles of marked nature trails, estate grounds, and historic structures.
cards.source_title: Nassau County: Muttontown Preserve
cards.access_notes: Use official maps and preserve rules; conditions on natural trails can vary with weather and maintenance.

cards.title: Sands Point Preserve
cards.subtitle: Middle Neck Road corridor
cards.notes: Choose a self-guided route across the gardens and forest trails, then check the conservancy’s visitor guidance for admissions and mansion tours.
cards.short_summary: A 216-acre preserve with historic mansions, gardens, trails, and pond areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Sands Point Preserve is a 216-acre county-owned park with historic mansions, gardens, forest trails, and pond areas.
cards.source_title: Sands Point Preserve Conservancy: About
cards.access_notes: Grounds access, admission, and mansion-tour schedules are set by the conservancy and should be checked before travel.

cards.entity_name: Tilles Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Tilles Center for the Performing Arts
cards.subtitle: Northern Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Review the official calendar for a suitable show, then use that event’s page for ticket details, start time, and any age-specific policies.
cards.short_summary: A Brookville performing-arts venue with a current public events calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: Tilles Center publishes a public calendar of concerts, dance, speakers, family programming, and other performances at 720 Northern Boulevard.
cards.source_title: Tilles Center for the Performing Arts: Events
cards.access_notes: Tickets and entry terms are event-specific; select an event that is appropriate for your age group.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented recurring New York Tech celebrations, showcases, and ceremonies connected to the Long Island campus and university community.

cards.title: MayFest
cards.subtitle: End-of-academic-year celebration
cards.notes: Watch New York Tech’s event listings near the end of spring term, then join the campus activities scheduled for that year’s MayFest.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing university tradition marking the close of the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech identifies MayFest as a long-standing tradition and reported its 2024 celebration across both New York campuses.
cards.source_title: MayFest 2024 | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Programming, locations, and participation details vary by year; consult the university’s current event listings.

cards.entity_name: Symposium of University Research and Creative Expression (SOURCE)
cards.title: SOURCE Research Showcase
cards.subtitle: University-wide student research tradition
cards.notes: If you are presenting, prepare your abstract and poster early; otherwise, attend the sessions to see research from across New York Tech.
cards.short_summary: An annual forum for students to present research and creative work.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech calls SOURCE an annual tradition; the 2024 event was its 21st celebration and included students from Long Island, New York City, and Vancouver.
cards.source_title: 21st Annual SOURCE Showcases Student Research | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: The source documents the annual event; venue and presentation requirements are set for each year’s program.

cards.entity_name: Undergraduate Research and Entrepreneurship Program (UREP) Showcase
cards.title: UREP Showcase
cards.subtitle: Engineering and computing project presentations
cards.notes: Build a project with a faculty mentor during the academic year, then plan to demonstrate the result at the annual UREP showcase.
cards.short_summary: Student teams present faculty-mentored research and entrepreneurship projects.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech described the 2025 UREP showcase as the program’s eighth annual showcase and said UREP has operated since 2018.
cards.source_title: UREP Spotlights Innovative Student Research | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: UREP is administered through the College of Engineering and Computing Sciences; project participation is program-specific.

cards.title: Aletheia
cards.subtitle: School of Health Professions spring symposium
cards.notes: Health Professions students can use the spring symposium as a deadline to refine capstone findings, a poster, and an oral presentation.
cards.short_summary: A recurring research-presentation ritual for health professions students.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech states that Aletheia is held every spring and gives School of Health Professions students a venue to showcase research and defend capstones.
cards.source_title: Health Professions Students Shine at Aletheia | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: The 2025 symposium took place in Riland Auditorium on the Long Island campus; annual scheduling may change.

cards.title: Community Engagement Day
cards.subtitle: University day of service
cards.notes: Choose a listed volunteer activity or organize with a campus group when New York Tech announces its annual Community Engagement Day.
cards.short_summary: A university-wide service day that extends volunteer work through April.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech described Community Engagement Day as an annual day of service and reported its sixth observance in 2024.
cards.source_title: Community Engagement Day 2024 | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: The 2024 observance was officially April 10, with volunteer opportunities continuing throughout the month.

cards.title: Taste of Nations
cards.subtitle: NYITCOM cultural performance event
cards.notes: Look for the Student National Medical Association’s call for performers and contribute a performance, fashion, music, or cultural presentation.
cards.short_summary: An annual NYITCOM gathering combining cultural performances and global cuisine.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech identifies Taste of Nations as an annual NYITCOM event hosted by the Student National Medical Association.
cards.source_title: Taste of Nations | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Participation and event details are organized by NYITCOM and the Student National Medical Association for each year.

cards.title: Student Speaker and Singer
cards.subtitle: Long Island commencement roles
cards.notes: Graduating students interested in the ceremony should follow commencement communications for student speaker and singer selection information.
cards.short_summary: Graduates deliver a speech and sing the national anthem at commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech says it is tradition for graduating students to deliver a commencement speech and sing the national anthem.
cards.source_title: Meet the Class of 2025 Speaker and Singer | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: The cited 2025 ceremony was scheduled on the Long Island campus; selection procedures can differ by commencement cycle.

cards.title: New Faculty Welcome Reception
cards.subtitle: NYIT de Seversky Mansion, Long Island
cards.notes: New faculty can use the orientation reception to meet colleagues and learn the university’s priorities before the academic year begins.
cards.short_summary: A recurring official welcome for newly hired New York Tech faculty.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech described its August 2024 new-faculty reception at NYIT de Seversky Mansion as part of its tradition of officially welcoming new faculty.
cards.source_title: New Academic Year Brings New Faculty | New York Tech

boards.title: Your First Weekend at New York Institute of Technology, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented to New York Tech’s Long Island campus: start with the grounds, then connect with campus spaces, food, creative work, recreation, and history.

cards.entity_name: New York Tech Long Island Campus
cards.title: Start with a campus walk
cards.subtitle: Old Westbury · 1st stop
cards.notes: Use the campus map to orient yourself to the tree-lined grounds and choose a few buildings to recognize before weekday routines begin.
cards.short_summary: A first pass through the Old Westbury campus grounds and pathways.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech identifies its Long Island campus as being in Old Westbury and describes it as a 168-acre campus with green spaces and pathways.
cards.source_title: Visit | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Use the university’s campus-map link and follow campus visitor/access guidance.

cards.title: Get your bearings at the Academic Quad
cards.subtitle: Long Island campus · 2nd stop
cards.notes: Pause at the named Academic Quad and locate Salten Hall, Harry J. Schure Hall, Theobald Science Center, and Anna Rubin Hall on the map.
cards.short_summary: A practical checkpoint for finding core academic buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech’s Long Island campus map labels an Academic Quad containing Salten Hall, Harry J. Schure Hall, Theobald Science Center, and Anna Rubin Hall.
cards.source_title: Long Island Campus Map | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Outdoor circulation and building access may vary; consult the campus map and posted access information.

cards.title: Find the Student Activity Center
cards.subtitle: Long Island campus · 3rd stop
cards.notes: Make the SAC your student-life landmark: note where Student Life, counseling, Career Services, dining, and the Grizzly Cupboard are listed.
cards.short_summary: A central campus destination for student-support and activity resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Long Island campus map lists Student Life, Career Services, Counseling & Wellness, Cool Beans Café, and the Grizzly Cupboard at the Student Activity Center.
cards.source_title: Long Island Campus Map | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Student services and indoor areas may require current student access; check the relevant office before visiting.

cards.title: Take a relaxed SAC break at Orso
cards.subtitle: Student Activity Center · 4th stop
cards.notes: Use the lounge as a short reset between exploring buildings; if you want food or a drink, check current café availability and pay at checkout.
cards.short_summary: A lounge and café space within the Student Activities Center.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech says Orso Café and its adjacent lounge are in the Student Activities Center, with the lounge created as a community-enjoyment space.
cards.source_title: Completed Projects | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Café purchases require payment; confirm current café service and building access before relying on it.

cards.title: Locate the recreation facilities
cards.subtitle: Activities/Recreation area · 5th stop
cards.notes: Walk over to identify the Recreation Center, Fitness Center, and Gymnasium so you know where to ask about current recreational access or programs.
cards.short_summary: A named campus recreation destination beside the Student Activity Center.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech’s Long Island campus map identifies the Recreation Center, Fitness Center, and Gymnasium in the Activities/Recreation area.
cards.source_title: Long Island Campus Map | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Facility use and programming can have separate eligibility or access requirements; verify with campus recreation staff.

cards.title: Settle into Salten Commons
cards.subtitle: Salten Hall · 6th stop
cards.notes: Try a brief reading or planning session in the commons, then make a note of the library location for a future study visit.
cards.short_summary: A Salten Hall gathering and study area with seating and library access.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech says Salten Commons includes open gathering spaces, study pods, group seating, couches, and a new home for the library.
cards.source_title: Completed Projects | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Indoor access may be limited to the campus community or affected by building hours; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Plan a Salten Café meal stop
cards.subtitle: Salten Hall, first floor · 7th stop
cards.notes: If you are hungry, check the café’s current offering and payment options; otherwise, simply mark its first-floor location for a later class day.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor campus dining location in Salten Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech lists Salten Café as a dining location on the first floor of Salten Hall and describes meal-plan payment through the OneCard.
cards.source_title: Meal Plans | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Food and drink require payment; confirm current service before visiting.

cards.title: Explore the art and architecture side
cards.subtitle: Art & Architecture area · 8th stop
cards.notes: Walk to Education Hall and identify the Art & Architecture Library and Ed Hall Café; save the location for a future quiet study or class break.
cards.short_summary: A named art-and-architecture building with a library and café.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech’s Long Island campus map lists Education Hall in the Art & Architecture area and identifies the Art & Architecture Library and Ed Hall Café there.
cards.source_title: Long Island Campus Map | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Library, café, and interior access can have separate operating conditions; check current campus information.

cards.title: Spot the Midge Karr Art & Design Center
cards.subtitle: Art & Architecture area · 9th stop
cards.notes: Add this named center to your campus mental map and look for any posted gallery, studio, or school programming that is open when you visit.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed art and design destination on the Long Island campus.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech’s Long Island campus map identifies the Midge Karr Art & Design Center in the Art & Architecture area.
cards.source_title: Long Island Campus Map | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: Gallery, studio, and building availability depends on current programming and access policies.

cards.title: Finish with the de Seversky Mansion grounds
cards.subtitle: Long Island campus · 10th stop
cards.notes: End with an exterior look at the historic mansion and grounds; use the venue’s directions page if you need the designated campus entrance and route.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus mansion that also serves as an event venue.
cards.evidence_claim: New York Tech states that the NYIT de Seversky Mansion is a historic Old Westbury campus landmark, built in 1916 and now used as an event venue.
cards.source_title: Campus Architecture & History | New York Tech
cards.access_notes: The mansion is an event venue; do not assume interior public access. Arrange a tour or attend only an authorized event.
